peri_megadim.en: And there is no 17, it is possible for anyone who must accept a ban on him by reversal and the like, after all, there is no one who accepts a ban on him until after the the Master's Day and who if he wants, the authority is in his hand. On the Shabbat Shabbat, between Rab and Yohak, they say Tzotz, even when it falls on the Sunday of Apa, they say on Shabbat in the Menha Tzot Dabhol Nami, they say in the Menha before which there is a supplication in front of it, they do not fall on the eve of Yohak.

turei_zahav.he: ואין נותנין חרם. שלא לעורר כחות הדין בזמן ההוא וכן אין משביעין שחוששין ביותר להביא עונש שבוע' לעולם ח"ו אבל לעשו' דין בין אדם לחבירו ודאי מצוה רבה יש לדון וכ"כ בלבוש מטעם דכשיש דין למטה אין דין למעלה:
turei_zahav.en: There is no boycott. Not to arouse the power of judgment at this time, nor is there any claim that it is most desirable to bring a week sentence to the world, but to do a judgment between a person and a great conscience, one must be discussed and so in the clothing of a lawyer below:
